svg.aria-label: CertifAI dark splash screen – Get certified in AI. Powered by asbots.com
svg.title: CertifAI – Get certified in AI (Dark Splash)
svg.script: /* tap / click anywhere to replay the splash (works when the SVG is opened directly) */ document.documentElement.addEventListener('click',function(){var r=document.documentElement;r.classList.remove('play');void r.getBoundingClientRect();r.classList.add('play');try{document.documentElement.setCurrentTime(0);}catch(e){}});
